description: The pie chart presents the distribution of video/content categories, shown as 14 slices with percentage labels inside each segment and category names placed around the perimeter, with no separate legend and no slices visually exploded or offset. The slices are: People Blogs (brown) at about 17.2%, Entertainment (purple) at about 13.9%, Howto Style (green) at about 9.7%, Education (maroon) at about 8.7%, Sports (lavender) at about 7.7%, Science Technology (blue-gray) at about 6.4%, Comedy (teal) at about 5.6%, Gaming (dark gray) at about 6.4%, Autos Vehicles (reddish) at about 4.8%, Film Animation (dark taupe) at about 4.6%, Travel Events (olive) at about 4.6%, News Politics (orange-brown) at about 4.3%, Pets Animals (green) at about 3.9%, and Music (light purple) at about 2.3%. The segments do not appear to follow a strict ascending or descending order by size.
